displayName: UE4 screen-space reflection trace and temporal resolve
description: Full-screen pixel pass that reconstructs the reflected ray from G-buffer geometry, marches hierarchical depth, reprojects temporal data with velocity, samples scene color or reflection history, and writes reflection radiance plus hit confidence.

hashFastPaths.evidence: Live solid-magenta A/B selectively marked reflective/specular materials, including wet ground, metal, fencing, and a smaller hair contribution, while leaving the HUD intact.

checks.meaning: A 3D frame-varying noise sequence jitters screen-space reflection rays.
The pass binds G-buffer normal and material data, scene depth, hierarchical depth, velocity, and two scene-color or reflection-history inputs.
The trace seed is loaded directly from the 3D noise volume.
A bounded loop advances the reflected ray through screen space.
The hierarchical-depth dimensions bound the ray-march coordinates.
Each ray step tests the reflected ray against hierarchical scene depth.
Motion vectors reproject the valid reflection hit into temporal history.
Two scene-color or reflection-history inputs are resolved at the reprojected hit.
Repeated vector normalization and reflection tests reconstruct view geometry and the reflected direction.
Reflection radiance is written separately to RGB, enabling strength control without corrupting the hit mask.
The reflection hit or confidence mask is preserved independently in alpha.
Material rejection and failed ray hits explicitly return no reflection.

runtimeContract.output: screen-space reflection radiance RGB plus hit or confidence alpha
adapterMustConfirm: RGB-only strength behavior with alpha preserved
runtimeContract.outputEncodingStatus: Reflection coverage is live-verified. Consecutive-draw resource flow proves the downstream composite uses SSR RGB additively and one minus SSR alpha for environment fallback. Total-zero RGBA and safe RGB-only zero both produced no visible difference in the tested scene while reflections were enabled, so strength remains unconfirmed and runtime promotion is blocked pending a screen-space-only reflection view.
runtimeContract.controlSafety: Scale output RGB only. Preserve output alpha because downstream stages may use it as reflection-hit confidence or temporal validity.
